t: Queen Victoria introduced the Victoria Cross, originally to recognise acts of valour by British military personnel during the Crimean War.
Major Henry C. Wayne arrived in Indianola, Texas, with 34 camels to form the short-lived United States Camel Corps.
A crowd of about 800 pro-slavery Americans ransacked the town of Lawrence, Kansas.
Senator Charles Sumner was assaulted by Representative Preston Brooks in the United States Senate chamber in retaliation for a speech in which Sumner fiercely criticized slaveholders.
The first company of Mormon handcart pioneers left Iowa City for Salt Lake City, Utah.
The first story from the collection Scenes of Clerical Life by the English author George Eliot was submitted for publication.
William III unilaterally revised the constitution of Luxembourg, greatly expanding his powers as grand duke.
